THE IDEA

A piano is a playground for dexterity. DexPiano explores how two robot hands can coordinate across a keyboard, connecting human demonstrations, motion priors, and reinforcement learning in a shared simulation and hardware workflow.

01 / THE APPROACH

From human motion
